owner_chapter: EMPTY. One row per concept that more than one chapter touches.
WHY: each concept is explained in exactly one chapter. Every other chapter refers to it
and does not re-teach it. Without an owner, each chapter re-teaches it slightly differently
and the reader cannot tell which version is right.
A gate fails on: two chapters claiming one concept; a chapter teaching a concept it does
WHEN A SUBJECT MOVES BETWEEN CYCLES: do not delete the row. Set owner_chapter to the new
chapter, record the old one in previous_owner, and date it in moved_on. A concept whose
ownership has moved twice is a signal the carving is wrong.
Duplication BETWEEN this book and any other is permitted and expected. Duplication
WITHIN this book is what this file prevents. They are different rules.
